question:

Create and output a new table with the file name "2025 November 1 calculation results.xlsx", where: rows represent dates (2025-10-01 to 2025-10-31, 31 rows total; retain the date row even if there is no data for that day, filling the supply volume with 0); columns represent the different "Cargo Name" values (aggregate types), arranged from left to right in ascending order of the pinyin of the first character of each name; cell values represent the supply volume of that aggregate on that day.
Dates are sorted in ascending chronological order (October 1 at the top, October 31 at the bottom). Values are rounded to 2 decimal places.
